_note: The stated futures book for the P&L attribution: quantities in contracts (positive long), held continuously and rolled on each product's roll date; 'core' and 'hedge' label the two halves of each relative-value pair so the attribution can show what the hedge cost. Cash is the collateral pool that funds the margin.
name: index-curve-commodity book

intraday._note: the passive market maker replayed on the MBO tape: one lot each side at the touch, joined at the back of the queue, re-quoted when the touch moves, inventory hedged at the opposite touch when it reaches the limit
